scope: Policy-to-UX proposal only. No release candidate was assessed.
critical_conclusion: Keep technical status, recommendation, decision certainty, and human authorization separate.

decision_fields.label: Technical status
decision_fields.rule: Show the controlling condition and its reason beside the status.

decision_fields.label: Recommendation
decision_fields.rule: Keep analyst advice separate from technical status and human authorization.

decision_fields.label: Decision certainty
decision_fields.rule: Always show the supported recommendation beside the evidence score.

decision_fields.label: Human authorization
decision_fields.field: Existing human readiness and deployment authorization fields
decision_fields.rule: Show the actual decision source, actor, time, scope, and validity when supplied.
decision_fields.limit: Assistant recommendations cannot populate human decision fields.

scoring_rules.formula: 20 * min(scores of dimensions directly controlling the recommendation)
scoring_rules.failure_example: Direct proof of a material failure can support NO_GO with HIGH decision certainty, scored 100/100.
scoring_rules.interpretation_limit: The score is neither a readiness percentage nor a production success probability.
scoring_rules.closure_limit: Fixing a proven failure can improve readiness without increasing an evidence score already at five.

technical_status_rules.GO: Mandatory conditions are supported. Critical scores reach four. Artifact, target, configuration, and recovery evidence are bound.
technical_status_rules.CONDITIONAL: No mandatory failure exists, but explicit bounded limits remain. Reassess all GO conditions after closure.
technical_status_rules.NO_GO: Evidence establishes a material failure or an unmet mandatory condition.
technical_status_rules.BLOCKED: Foundational identity, scope, artifact, target, or intake evidence is unknown without a controlling demonstrated failure.
technical_status_rules.authorization_limit: Human authorization alone does not resolve failed or unknown conditions.

overview_proposal.word_target: 300 words or fewer before supporting detail
essential_fields: Candidate, build, artifact, target, and assessment time
Technical status, recommendation, and decision certainty
Controlling failure reasons and prioritized actions
Largest business consequence and broadest supported system effect
Material evidence gaps and freshness limits
overview_proposal.failure_pattern: Show failure, reason, consequence, owner, next action, and closure evidence together.
overview_proposal.layout_confidence: MODERATE. Placement is a design inference. User review remains necessary.

supporting_sections.label: Impact
supporting_sections.content: Business journeys, consequences, system consumers, dependencies, compatibility, exposure, and recovery scope.

supporting_sections.label: Code review
supporting_sections.content: Exact comparison, inspected scope, findings, resolution evidence, exclusions, and unassessed paths.

supporting_sections.label: Requirements and traceability
supporting_sections.content: Active requirements, defect criteria, implementation links, assertion chains, conformance gaps, and retained execution.

supporting_sections.label: Execution
supporting_sections.content: Candidate-bound outcomes, failures, skipped cases, first-run failures, retries, configuration, environment, and stale evidence.

supporting_sections.label: Deployment and recovery
supporting_sections.content: Artifact provenance, target configuration, deployment order, migration, compatibility, monitoring, stop triggers, and recovery evidence.

supporting_sections.label: Risks and decisions
supporting_sections.content: Consequence, exposure, mitigation, owner, actual disposition, exception authority, scope, and validity.

supporting_sections.label: Assessment evidence
supporting_sections.content: Dimension scorecard, metric rules, exact identities, evidence links, rationale, applicability, and limits.

required_when: A material dimension is FAILED, LIMITED, or UNKNOWN
action_contract.closure_rule: Inspect closure evidence and bind it to the candidate before closing an action.

release_clinic.proposal: Keep the direct Release Clinic link within release compliance.
release_clinic.evidence_role: Clinic findings supplement the combined assessment within their own scope, identities, versions, and limits.
release_clinic.limit: A Clinic verdict, pipeline success, or quality gate does not establish complete business verification.

misleading_ui_risks: A green certainty gauge can imply readiness when direct evidence proves a blocking failure.
One Go badge can merge technical advice with missing human authorization.
Averaged scores can hide a controlling mandatory failure.
A clean review can conceal excluded paths or imply that no defects exist.
Passing totals can hide skipped cases, retries, stale results, or candidate mismatches.
A combined coverage percentage can merge links, assertions, conformance, execution, and measured code coverage.
Approval labels can conceal an unresolved failure or unsupported exception.

source_conflict.issue: The release-confidence coverage reference uses N/A for both unknown and empty denominators.
source_conflict.resolution: Use UNKNOWN for unavailable complete inventories. Reserve N/A for known empty denominators.
source_conflict.priority_basis: Latest project instructions require explicit unresolved scope. The implementation-verification procedure also distinguishes these states.
source_conflict.limit: This review records the proposal rule. It does not modify the conflicting skill reference.

assessment_limits: No candidate, deployment, or approval evidence was assessed.
No actual release status, recommendation, certainty score, or human decision was assigned.
Prototype values must remain clearly illustrative.
Policy confidence is HIGH within the inspected source versions.
Layout confidence is MODERATE until the user reviews the combined proposal.

limitations: Automated checks do not check the complete approved dictionary or grammar rules.
